title: Add Cloudflare to Flask Hosting Platforms docs?
author: hoodmane
body_preview: Cloudflare workers supports deploying Flask applications. We have the following short guide for deploying Flask workers: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/languages/python/packages/flask/  Could we add a link to this page to the "Hosting Platforms" section of the docs?

title: Deprecate WSGI functions
author: davidism
body_preview: https://werkzeug.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/levels/#high-or-low suggests that you might want to choose to use the individual utility functions on an `environ` rather than using `Request`. But I'm not sure any of the reasons hold up.  `Request` is an extremely lightweight wrapper around `environ`. There's essentially no cost to constructing it, and then it offers a way better (and more complete)...

title: Some middleware can use `Request.application`
author: davidism
body_preview: All middleware right now uses `__call__(self, environ, start_response)`. Some of them would benefit from the `Request.application` decorator to work with a `Request` instead of an `environ`. Not all of them, some like `ProxyFix` are more focused on the `environ` itself.

title: `make_conditional` has a lot of problems
author: davidism

title: pass `request` instead of `environ` where possible
author: davidism
body_preview: `Request` has a bunch of header properties that cache the result of parsing. Werkzeug has a bunch of individual functions that work on `environ`, meaning everything needs to be re-parsed everywhere. Some functions (but not consistently) accept a `Request` or `environ`, but then pick `request.environ`, so they're not actually benefiting. title: Should we remove the interactive debugger?
author: davidism
body_preview: What if we removed the interactive debugger?  - Its implementation is ridiculously complex.
